summary: Staging proxy causes embed requests to be billed at hosted hourly rate (metering tag misattribution)
description: Issue summary: Customer reports a sudden increase in cost for embedding calls after they started routing traffic through their staging proxy. They observe embeddings charged at the hosted "hourly" embed rate instead of the expected dedicated reserved rate. Impact: Unexpected invoice increase for current billing period and confusion over credit application. Environment: Production requests proxied from customer staging host into Redwood api-gateway via our reverse proxy (forwarded X-Request-Origin headers).
impact: Customer reported +18% invoice delta on the last 48h for embed usage; affects billing reconciliation and may trigger finance escalation if not resolved within SLA.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer routes embed requests through their staging proxy to Redwood API endpoint with header X-Forwarded-Host set.
2) Requests hit the api-gateway and are routed to usage-postback service.
3) Postback records metering tags based on origin header mapping.
4) Observed: meter recorded as hosted-hourly-embed instead of dedicated-reserved-embed for same API key.
logs: Postback trace snippet (us-east, 2026-03-11T22:14:02Z): request_id=8f7a1c, api_key=live-lyra-01, origin_header=staging.lyra.internal, resolved_org=lyra-prod, selected_rate=hosted-hourly-embed, kv_cache_hit=true
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: staging proxy rewrites or omits the original origin->tenant header leading postback to fallback to default hosted rate.
Checked routing logs: requests identified with api_key correctly mapped to LyraSearch org.
Postback mapping: we prioritize X-Client-Region + origin tag; if origin tag matches a staging domain pattern we apply hosted fallback (legacy behavior introduced 2025-09).
Search of past incidents: SUP-314777 touched postback heuristics for unrecognized hostnames.
Correlation: all affected requests in the sample were proxied and had X-Forwarded-Host set to staging hostname which matches our staging pattern and triggers fallback to hosted rate.
Repro on internal staging: able to reproduce using curl with X-Forwarded-Host=staging.lyra.internal — postback selected hosted-hourly-embed rate.
Root cause: heuristic in usage-postback that treats any origin hostname containing "staging" as non-production and forces hosted rate; staging proxy preserved that hostname in forwarded headers.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Maya Chen: Customer opened asking why identical embed jobs are billed differently after switching to staging proxy. Provided example invoice lines and sample request headers.

2026-03-11 - Arjun Patel: Assigned for triage. Reproduced locally against postback service. Added preliminary hypothesis that origin host heuristics are overbroad. Linking SUP-314777 which updated host heuristics earlier.

2026-03-12 - SRE (Jordan Lee): Confirmed logs show X-Forwarded-Host contains 'staging'. Postback code path in prod branch checks 'staging' substring. Created hotfix branch to relax heuristic and prioritize api_key org mapping first. See PR #742.
2026-03-13 - Finance (Elena Rossi): Requested provisional credit estimate and that we notate invoice until fix is deployed. Will hold escalation to billing team until resolution.

2026-03-13 - Arjun Patel: Deployed hotfix to canary (us-east). Canary traffic for LyraSearch shows postback now mapping to dedicated-reserved-embed rate for proxied requests. Preparing rollout and provisional credit calculation.
resolution:
Workaround applied: updated usage-postback heuristics to prefer api_key->org mapping over origin-hostname heuristics and deployed hotfix to canary. Full rollout to us-east prod scheduled 2026-03-14 02:00 UTC after monitoring window.
Customer remediation: no changes required on their side; they may optionally strip 'staging' from forwarded host to avoid previous heuristic.
Follow-up: engineering to remove substring-based 'staging' rule and add explicit allowlist for known staging domains; add unit tests and a migration plan for postback config. Finance to apply provisional credit outlined below.
estimated_credit: $186.24 provisional (48h window) — pending final reconciliation after 72h post-rollout
